beats.text: We keep asking God for the promise.
The house. The healing. The breakthrough.
Read what He actually said about Abraham.
I have singled him out so that he will direct his children to keep the way of the Lord. Then I will do all that I have promised.
He will teach his children. Then I will do it.
The training came first. The promise came after.
That is uncomfortable. It is also the point.
What are you building at home while you wait?
